targets.expr:
sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name) (container_cpu_usage{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_pod_name=~"$pod"}) 
/ on(k8s_pod_name) group_left()
sum by (k8s_pod_name) (label_replace(k8s_container_cpu_limit{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}, "k8s_pod_name", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Pod CPU Utilization Over Pod Limit

targets.expr:
sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_pod_name=~"$pod"}) 
/ on(k8s_pod_name) group_left()
sum by (k8s_pod_name) (label_replace(k8s_container_memory_limit_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}, "k8s_pod_name", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Pod Memory Utilization Over Pod Limits
